## Fish Analysis

Load tidyverse

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

fish_data <- read.csv("../data/Gaeta_etal_CLC_data.csv")

head(fish_data)
```

Summary statistics for fish scale length.

```{r}
min_max_length <- fish_data |> 
  summarise(min_scale_length=min(scalelength, na.rm = T),
            max_scale_length= max(scalelength, na.rm=T),
            mean_scale_length= mean(scalelength, narm=T))
```
